review_scope: Full 21-line user-settings article and four full feature/navigation/gated fragments read. Screenshot link and alt text inspected as text only, not image bytes or rights clearance. No account setting changed.

claims.statement: User-protection applicability delegates to a dedicated feature and product include rather than inheriting repository-protection applicability.
The procedure changes the personal user's push-protection setting through account security settings, not repository settings; documentation is not authority to disable protection.
The screenshot alt text describes a Disable button; this is neither actual account-state readback nor observed blocking behavior.
User push protection is declared for fpt and ghec with no GHES range in the pinned feature file.
The gated fragment describes user protection enabled by default for public repositories; it does not assert private-repository protection.
The account-settings navigation starts from the user's profile menu; navigation does not establish permission to mutate another account.
The security-settings fragment directs navigation to Code security; presence of that page does not verify protection state.
